reference_sql:
WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, units,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC) AS place
  FROM store_units
)
SELECT store_code, product_id, units
FROM ranked
WHERE place <= 2
alternatives:
WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
)
SELECT su.store_code, su.product_id, su.units
FROM store_units su
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_units su2
       WHERE su2.store_code = su.store_code AND su2.units > su.units) < 2

SELECT t.store_code, t.product_id, t.units
FROM (
  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC) AS place
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.place <= 2

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY store_code, product_id),
r AS (SELECT store_code, product_id, units, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC) AS place FROM p)
SELECT store_code, product_id, units FROM r WHERE place <= 2
